name: Gayatri Sugars Limited
about: Gayatri Sugars Limited manufactures and sells sugar and allied products in India. It operates through Sugar and Distillery segments. The company offers white sugar from sugar cane; distillery products, including ethanol and impure spirits; by-products, such as molasses and bagasse; and hand sanitizers. It also trades in fertilizers, acetone, and methanol, as well as scraps, ash, and filter cakes. In addition, the company generates power from bagasse. The company was formerly known as NCS Gayatri Sugars Ltd and changed its name to Gayatri Sugars Limited in August 2003. Gayatri Sugars Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
